[color=#ff9999]My first Stardew mod (phew) - bit of a learning curve but thank you to those in the community who supported my grand ideas for a collection of Cardcaptor Sakura mods for this game. If it wasn't for that support this mod wouldn't exist :3[/color]

[color=#ff9999]Go [/color][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/walpi-chan-mods-everything-kawaii.131406/]here[/url][color=#ff9999] to keep up with my progress on the rest of my CCS Collection, and other kawaii and anime-related mods (whenever I finish something, it'll be uploaded here).[/color]

[/font][center][font=Verdana][color=#ff9999]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/font][/center][font=Verdana][color=#e06666][size=3][b]The Mod[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ff9999]Kero replaces the pet cat and comes with more Kero-like animations ripped straight from the anime. He eats strawberry shortcake and falls asleep when he's done with a big round tummy and crumbs on the edges of his mouth! :3[/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#ff9999]
[/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#ff9999]Yes, he's a lot bigger than Kero in his small form is, but I care more about making him look like Kero than sticking to height restrictions [s]so instead he's a monster.[/s][/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#ff9999]
[/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][color=#ff9999]A Spinel Sun dog replacement is coming soon (and will be uploaded on this page), which you can use alongside this mod with the help of keyten's [/color][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cat-and-dog-at-the-same-time.110225/]guide[/url][color=#ff9999] for having both a cat and dog on your farm at the same time.[/color]

[color=#e06666][size=3][b]How to Install
[/b][/size][/color][/font]
→ Download the .rar file from the [Downloads] tab above
→ On your desktop, open the directory the .rar file was saved to (usually 'Downloads' folder) and extract the cat.xnb file (use WinRAR/something similar)
→ Open the Stardew Valley Content directory in a new window - this is where you move all the .xnb file mods you want to use in your game:
[quote]Usually this directory is under:
Program Files (x86) → Steam → steamapps → common → Stardew Valley → Content[/quote]→ Once in Content, open the Animals folder and find the cat.xnb file inside. Create a back-up somewhere else, just in case something goes wrong with the mod (it's unlikely but better to be safe than sorry), then delete it
→ Now go back to your Downloads folder and copy the new cat.xnb file you just downloaded into the Animals folder
→ You're done! Start your game up and Kero should be floating around your farm in all of his adorable glory! Waai~
